Type: acceptance gate
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: W01
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend and frontend engineers
Pilot scope: required

Outcome: Curators can create and populate a dataset and researchers can obtain verified full exports through supported product workflows.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Expose authorized creation, approved staging intake and/or bounded resumable upload through durable operation contracts, with quotas and source-evidence isolation; reject arbitrary server paths.
2. Show scope, findings, progress and supported retry/cancel/resume actions; preserve atomic publication and allow mapping/metadata decisions without database edits.
3. Provide durable full-export planning, progress, verified delivery and interruption recovery under current authority; demonstrate complete browser/API journeys on supported native BIDS.

Review all child evidence against these integration criteria. Children closing does not automatically close this gate. Required human/institutional evidence must be observed, never inferred from automated tests.
